verdict.KBD-03: AGREES. Both apps move row focus on both arrow keys and on j/k, in both directions, landing each step on the row's own title-bearing element.
verdict.KBD-04: AGREES on both clauses — focus wraps at the end and the cycle includes the Add-task affordance and completed rows — with one architectural difference already recorded: Todoist's Add-task stop is a plain BUTTON, meologue's is a live text field, so meologue needs its caret-at-the-edge rule to pass through it where Todoist needs nothing. meologue additionally has to open a collapsed <details> to reach its completed rows, which Todoist has no equivalent of.
